action: Replaced the remaining test-level inference about legacy client initialization sequencing with exact source-level evidence from the pinned Rust SDK client startup path.
observations: Service startup obtains client_info from service.get_info(); in ClientLifecycleMode::Initialize it awaits legacy_startup(..., client_info).await? before continuing.

legacy_startup constructs InitializeRequest with params: client_info and sends it as ClientRequest::InitializeRequest(init_request), so the ClientInfo payload supplied by the service is carried in the initialize request.
legacy_startup then awaits the correlated initialize response and requires ServerResult::InitializeResult; any other successful response shape returns ClientInitializeError::ExpectedInitResult.

After accepting InitializeResult and setting peer info, legacy_startup sends ClientNotification::InitializedNotification. A send failure is converted to ClientInitializeError and propagated by ?, and the helper returns Ok(()) only after that send succeeds.
